Classes

GridTestScene

An abstract test case which exposes small cells arranged in a grid. Useful for displaying multiple configurations of a tested component at a glance.

HeadlessTestAttribute

Denotes a "visual" test which should only be run in a headless context. This will stop the test from showing up in a osu.Framework.Testing.TestBrowser.

ManualInputManagerTestScene

An abstract test case which is tested with manual input management.

MenuTestScene.MenuStructure

Helper class used to retrieve various internal properties/items from a osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface.Menu.

MenuTestScene

A test scene that provides a set of helper functions and structures for testing a osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface.Menu.

SetUpStepsAttribute

Denotes a method which adds osu.Framework.Testing.TestScene steps. Invoked via osu.Framework.Testing.TestScene.RunSetUpSteps (which is called from nUnit's [SetUp] or osu.Framework.Testing.TestBrowser.LoadTest(System.Type,System.Action,System.Boolean)).

SoloAttribute

Denotes a single test method which will be "solo"ed during visual execution. This implies all other tests will be ignored.

TearDownStepsAttribute

Denotes a method which adds osu.Framework.Testing.TestScene steps at the end. Invoked via osu.Framework.Testing.TestScene.RunTearDownSteps (which is called from nUnit's [TearDown] or osu.Framework.Testing.TestBrowser.LoadTest(System.Type,System.Action,System.Boolean)).

TemporaryNativeStorage

A temporary storage that can be used for testing purposes. Writes files to the OS temporary directory and cleans up on disposal.

TestRunHeadlessGameHost

A GameHost which writes to the system temporary directory, attempting to clean up after the test run completes. Also runs in non-realtime (allowing faster test execution) by default.
